title: Cauliflower Rice Burrito Bowl with Beans, Peppers, Guacamole & Cheese

steps.text: Drain and rinse beans; pat dry with paper towels. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into strips. Add to the baking sheet with the beans, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring once, until beans are warmed through and veggies are tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower, water, and salt to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid has evaporated and cauliflower is tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Divide cauliflower rice, beans, veggies, guacamole, and cheese between bowls. Serve with hot sauce on the side and enjoy!
